# 0.5.0 release plan: Paper Draft Contributions

Status: planning scaffold for [Problems #71](https://github.com/cmudrc/design-research-problems/issues/71) in the coordinated [Study to Evidence to Paper Draft release](https://github.com/cmudrc/design-research/issues/41). This file does not declare 0.5.0 released.

## Outcome

Supported problems can export curated, structured material for a paper draft while remaining independent of Experiments.

## Scope

- Add an explicit public adapter, provisionally `collect_problem_paper_contributions(...)`.
- Reuse the existing `Citation` and source-citation metadata rather than creating another bibliography model.
- Contribute background and methods blurbs, reporting requirements, prompt lineage, evaluator descriptions owned by the problem, citation keys, and evidence references.
- Record stable component identifiers plus package/version provenance.
- Mark incomplete contributions `partial` or `todo`; do not invent missing details.
- Support JSON-compatible interchange through the small versioned paper-contribution contract.

## Acceptance

- Peanut shelling exports its curated methodological context and three existing citations.
- A text/design problem such as laptop design exports prompt lineage and appropriate methods/background material.
- Citation output is deterministic and deduplicable.
- Missing required fields remain visible as reporting gaps.
- Existing problem APIs and artifact schema 0.2.0 compatibility remain intact.

## Non-goals

No dependency on Experiments, paper assembly, generated references, automatic literature review, or general narrative generation.
